question: On the shipped 0.15.0 build, with six fresh worlds, does the cap-112 allocation satisfy the full-window floor-plus-backfill identity and does the measured rank-21-40 band enter service, with the allocation law and band service able to fail independently?

program.question: Q054
program.relationship: BAND-1 froze an exact-56 allocation, observed 64-69, and was VOID on that gate. BAND-2 and BAND-3 corrected the point to a floor. BAND-4 is the confirmatory allocation block: it does not repeat the point, does not use 64-69 as a cutoff, and does not re-read BAND-1, BAND-2 or BAND-3. BAND-1 stays VOID; BAND-2 and BAND-3 stay unrun.

reconciliation.frozen_point: BAND-1's B5 required exactly 56 transitions at cap 112.
reconciliation.engine_law: `organica/sleep_extraction.py` sets `transition_budget = returned_budget // 2` (56 at 112), seats up to 56 cooccurrences in the remainder, then backfills unused cooccurrence slots with further transitions (`more_trans`). A full window therefore has `transitions + cooccurrences = 112` with `transitions >= 56` and `cooccurrences <= 56`.
reconciliation.observed_64_69: The six BAND-1 cells served 64-69 transitions, so their full-window cooccurrence counts were 48-43. That is the floor plus backfill; it is not a new allocation rule and it is not an acceptance threshold.
reconciliation.why_not_exact_56: A correct engine can serve more than 56 transitions whenever fewer than 56 cooccurrence candidates fill the remainder. Requiring exactly 56 rejects a healthy backfill.
reconciliation.why_not_floor_only: A floor-only gate accepts 56 transitions with no cooccurrences in a 56-row window. That is not the full allocation law and would pass without showing the backfill that produced 64-69. BAND-4 therefore requires a full 112-row window and the sum identity.
reconciliation.not_fitted: The law and its fixtures are written from `sleep_extraction.py` before any BAND-4 cell. The observed 64-69 is a consistency check, not a calibrated range, and no threshold is set to 64 or 69.

design.observer: the repaired observer of PRESENCE-CONVERSION-2, returning the engine's own served list and recording the pre-cap universe and allocation
design.world: the compositional world family of PHASE_ACQUISITION at 120 cycles on six fresh seeds; no Q4, BAND-1, BAND-2 or BAND-3 world is reused
design.pairing: each seed contributes one world and one stimulus to both caps; only the cap changes, and each band edge is paired across the two cells
design.freshness: All six seeds are fresh at freeze time: seed_collisions over every docs JSON returns no hit. The record and page are the only allowed artifacts that name them.
design.reuse: No prior block's cells, named band or result is reused. The 64-69 observation is cited only as the prior that motivates the allocation law; it is not BAND-4 evidence.

band.definition: For each seed, the band is every present transition whose minimum block rank in the cap-112 ceiling universe is 21-40. It is measured from the 112 arm and is not filtered by cap-40 service.
band.derivation: Read the cap-112 cell's present_edges and universe; keep each edge whose relation is transition and whose minimum recorded rank is 21-40. A missing rank is a failure, not a zero.
band.size: measured per seed; no fixed total
band.zero_band: A seed with zero rank-21-40 present transitions is a zero denominator: B6 fails and the block is VOID, never split as 0 served.
band.service_separation: Band membership is independent of cap-40 service and is not filtered by it. B4 measures whether the 40 arm served a band edge.

engine.treatment: only SleepService.MAX_PREDICTIONS is set per cell

endpoints.definition: world edges generated for the seed
world edges present in the temporal graph
present transitions at minimum block rank 21-40 in the 112 ceiling
band edges served in at least one cap-40 cycle
band edges served in at least one cap-112 cycle
band edges asserted at the end of the cap-112 run
per cycle transitions and cooccurrences in the 112 window
per edge: rank, cycles served at each cap, asserted, relation

gates.B1_build: all twelve cells run the shipped 0.15.0 build at the named cap, with one sha256 across the run and only MAX_PREDICTIONS overridden; a mixed or edited build is VOID
gates.B2_world_fresh: each seed's world digest and present fingerprint are identical at 40 and 112, and every seed is absent from every prior docs artifact; a different world or a reused seed is VOID
gates.B3_band_identity: at cap 112 every band edge is a present transition whose minimum recorded rank is 21-40 and whose rank is present; each seed's band is non-empty; a missing edge, duplicate, missing rank or out-of-band rank fails B3. The band is read before cap-40 service is considered.
gates.B4_control_40: at cap 40 no band edge is served on any seed, and the 40-row allocator satisfies the same sum identity with its 20-transition floor; a band edge served at 40, an incomplete full window, or a 40-row allocation that does not sum fails B4
gates.B5_allocation_law: at cap 112 every cell has at least one full 112-row window; every full window satisfies transitions >= 56, cooccurrences <= 56 and transitions + cooccurrences = 112, and every allocation row sums to its own served window. The maximum served transition rank is above block rank 40, every served edge parses as exactly one source>target, and every served transition is ranked. A 56-transition, 56-row window; a 64-transition, 104-row sum; a cooccurrence count above 56; a rank ceiling at 40; an unparseable edge; or an unranked served transition fails B5. B5 is not conditional on band service.
gates.B6_denominator: each seed's band is non-empty and every band edge reaches the ledger; a zero band or a zero P is not measurable and is VOID, never 0.0
gates.B7_determinism: a fresh-process rerun of seed 20612501 at 112 reproduces its per-edge ledger and allocation exactly
gates.B8_seed_axis: the six 112 ledgers hold at least three distinct served-band edge sets; a repeated set is one world, not six

b5_fixture.pass_64_plus_48: 64 transitions + 48 cooccurrences in a 112-row window, maximum rank 64
b5_fixture.pass_56_plus_56: 56 transitions + 56 cooccurrences in a 112-row window, maximum rank 56
b5_fixture.fail_rank_ceiling: a full window whose maximum served transition rank is 40
b5_fixture.fail_unranked: a served transition with no recorded rank
b5_fixture.fail_malformed: an edge with more than one source>target separator
b5_fixture.rule: the same allocation_law helper is used by the record check and the future arm; the pass fixtures cover both the observed backfill shape and the exact floor, and every failure fixture must fail

acceptance.criterion_a: B5 passes: the cap-112 allocation law holds on every full window and the rank ceiling is live.
acceptance.criterion_b: B3, B4 and B6 pass: every measured rank-21-40 band edge is served at 112, none is served at 40, and the seed axis is live.
acceptance.confirmed: CONFIRMED only when both criterion A and criterion B pass.
acceptance.independent_failure: The criteria fail independently: a block with perfect band service but a failed B5 is ALLOCATION LAW NOT CONFIRMED. A block with a perfect allocation but any unserved band edge is BAND NOT CONFIRMED. Neither result can be averaged into or rescued by the other.
acceptance.not_fitted: The 64-69 observation is not used as a threshold. The allocation identity is fixed from the engine source, and the band criterion is the same rank rule fixed before the cells.

decision_table.condition: B1, B2, B3 identity, B6, B7 or B8 fails
decision_table.reading: the block is unrun or non-reproducible and the failed gate names what did not happen
decision_table.decision: record VOID; fix the failed gate and register a new block; read no acceptance

decision_table.condition: allocation law fails, band service passes
decision_table.reading: the band can be served while the full-window floor-plus-backfill identity is false
decision_table.decision: report the allocation failure; do not call the band a confirmation; fix the allocation rule before another band block

decision_table.condition: allocation law passes, any band edge is unserved at 112 or served at 40
decision_table.reading: the allocation is correct but the measured rank-21-40 band does not enter service as claimed
decision_table.decision: report the per-edge misses; the next step is the admission rule, not another cap level

decision_table.condition: allocation law and band service both pass on every seed
decision_table.reading: the floor-plus-backfill law and fresh-world rank-21-40 service both hold
decision_table.decision: record the confirmation; the owner decides any engine or promotion step; no capability claim
